questions.question: If the internal dimensions of a rectangular closed wooden box are 30 cm, 18 cm and 23 cm, what space (in cm³) will it occupy, if the wood used is 1 cm thick?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of wooden box = 30 cm

Breadth of wooden box = 18 cm

Height of wooden box = 23 cm

Thickness of the wood = 1 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of the wooden box = L × B × H

**Calculation:**

External length of the wooden box = [30 + (1 + 1)] = 32 cm

External breadth of the wooden box = [18 + (1 + 1)] = 20 cm

External height of the wooden box = [23 + (1 + 1)] = 25 cm

Volume of the wooden box = (32 × 20 × 25) cm³

⇒ 16000 cm³

**∴ The required volume is 16000 cm³**

questions.question: A man sells two items at ₹ 250 each. What is the value (in ₹) of the profit or loss incurred in this transaction, if he sells one at a profit of 25% and the other at a loss of 25%?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SP of the two items = Rs. (250 + 250) = Rs. 500

Profit = 25%

Loss = 25%

**Formula used:**

Loss = CP – SP

**Calculation:**

CP for the article having sold on profit = Rs. (250 × 100/125)

⇒ Rs. 200

CP for the article having suffered loss = Rs. (250 × 100/75)

⇒ Rs. 333.33

Total CP of both articles = Rs. (200 + 333.33)

⇒ Rs. 533.33

Total SP of both articles = Rs. 500

Loss = (533.33 – 500) 

⇒ 33.33

**∴ The required loss is 33.33**

questions.question: Pipes P and Q can fill a completely empty tank in 24 minutes and in 36 minutes, respectively, when opened independently. Pipe R can empty the completely filled tank in 30 minutes. Initially all the three pipes P, Q and R, are opened simultaneously. After how many minutes should pipe Q be closed so that the tank is filled in 1 hour?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Pipe P to fill a tank = 24 min

Time taken by Pipe Q to fill a tank = 36 min

Time taken by Pipe R to fill a tank = 30 min

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

1 hour = 60 min

**Calculation:**

LCM of 24, 36 and 30 is 360

Let the height of the tank is 360m.

Efficiency of Pipe P = (360/24) = 15 i.e Pipe P can fill the tank at a rate of 15m/min

similarly,

Efficiency of Q = (360/36) = 10m/miin

Efficiency of R = (360/30) = 12m/min (rate of emptying the tank)

Now,

Let Pipe Q closed after x min

According to the question,

Pipe P will work for 60 min

Pipe Q will work for x min

Pipe R will work for 60 min

⇒ (15 × 60) + (10 × x) – (12 × 60) = 360

⇒ 900 + 10x – 720 = 360

⇒ 180 + 10x = 360

⇒ 10x = 180

⇒ x = 18 min

**∴ The required time is 18 min**

questions.question: What will be the compound interest (in ₹) on ₹ 10,000 for 2 years at 5% per annum, compounded annually?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 10,000

Rate = 5%

Time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)T

CI = A – P

**Calculation:**

According to the question

A = P(1 + R/100)T

⇒ A = 10,000 × (1 + 5/100)²

⇒ 10,000 × (105/100)²

⇒ (10,000 × 21/20 × 21/20)

⇒ (25 × 21 × 21)

⇒ Rs.11,025

Now,

CI = A – P

⇒ CI = Rs. (11,025 – 10,000)

⇒ Rs. 1025

**∴ The required CI is Rs. 1025**

questions.question: A boat sails downstream from a point P to point Q, which is 24 km away from P, and then returns to P. If the actual speed of the boat (in still water) is 6 km/h, the entire trip from P to Q takes 3 hours less than that from Q to P. What should be the actual speed (in km/h) of the boat to sail from P to Q in 2 hours?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A boat sails downstream from a point P to point Q, which is 24 km away from P

The actual speed of the boat (in still water) = 6 km/h

The entire trip from P to Q takes 3 hours less than that from Q to P.

**Formula used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

Speed in downstream = speed of boat in still water + speed of water flow

Speed in upstream = speed of boat in still water − speed of water flow

**Calculation:**

Let speed of stream be x km/hr

Distance between P and Q = 24 km

Time taken to travel upstream Q to P = 24/(6 – x)

Time taken to travel downstream P to Q = 24/(6 + x)

Now,

⇒ 24/(6 – x) – 24/(6 + x) = 3

⇒ 24(6 + x – 6 + x)/(6² – x²) = 3

⇒ 8(x + x)/(36 – x²) = 1

⇒ 16x = 36 – x²

⇒ x² + 16x – 36 = 0

⇒ x² – 2x + 18x – 36 = 0

⇒ x(x – 2) + 18(x – 2) = 0

⇒ (x – 2) (x + 18) = 0

⇒ x = 2 or -18

Now,

The actual speed of boat to sail from P to Q in 2 hours = 24/(B + W) = 2

⇒ 24/(B + 2) = 2

⇒ 12 = B + 2

⇒ B = (12 – 2)

⇒ B = 10 km/h

**∴ The actual speed of boat is 10 km/h**

questions.question: Which is the largest number that divides 827, 1149 and 1310 to leave the same remainder in each case?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The largest number dividing a, b, and c leaving the same remainder = HCF of |a − b|, |b − c|, |c − a|.

⇒ Difference 1 = |1149 − 827| = 322

⇒ Difference 2 = |1310 − 1149| = 161

⇒ Since 322 is a multiple of 161, their HCF is simply 161.

**∴ The correct answer is 161.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers are 827, 1149, and 1310.

**Formula Used:**

When the largest number divides x, y, and z to leave the same remainder in each case, the number is given by the HCF of their absolute differences: HCF(|x − y|, |y − z|, |z − x|).

**Calculation:**

⇒ First difference = |1149 − 827| = 322

⇒ Second difference = |1310 − 1149| = 161

⇒ Third difference = |1310 − 827| = 483

⇒ Now, we need to find the HCF of 322, 161, and 483.

⇒ Factorising the numbers:

⇒ 161 = 161 × 1

⇒ 322 = 161 × 2

⇒ 483 = 161 × 3

⇒ The Highest Common Factor (HCF) is clearly 161.

**∴ The correct answer is 161.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Case 1: Different Remainders

To find the largest number that divides x, y, and z leaving remainders a, b, and c respectively, calculate the HCF of (x − a), (y − b), and (z − c).

Case 2: Same Known Remainder

To find the largest number that divides x, y, and z leaving the same given remainder r in each case, calculate the HCF of (x − r), (y − r), and (z − r).

LCM Application

To find the smallest number which when divided by x, y, and z leaves the same remainder r, the formula is LCM(x, y, z) + r.
</p

questions.question: A man sells 30 apples for the cost price of 40 apples. His profit percentage (correct to two places of decimal) is :

SP of 30 apples = CP of 40 apples

Profit = SP – CP

questions.question: A number was divided by 8, instead of being multiplied by 8. As a result of this, there was an error in the answer. What is the percentage difference (correct to two places of decimal) in the answer due to this miscalculation?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A number was divided by 8, instead of being multiplied by 8.

**Calculation:**

Let the number be x

The resultant = x/8

The required result = 8x

Error = (8x – x/8)

⇒ (64x – x)/8

⇒ 63x/8

Percentage error = [(63x/8)/8x × 100]

⇒ (63x/64x × 100)

⇒ (63 × 25)/16

⇒ (1575/16)

⇒ 98.4375% ~ 98.44%

**∴ The required percentage error is 98.44%**

questions.question: Four years ago, the average age of a group of five members was 38 years. One more man joins the group and the present average age of the group members becomes 44 years. What is the present age (in years) of the new member?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Present average age of the 5 members = 38 + 4 = 42 years.

New average age of the 6 members = 44 years.

Age of new member = New Average + Old Members × Increase in Average

Age of new member = 44 + 5 × (44 − 42)

Age of new member = 44 + 10 = 54 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 54 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

⇒ Average age of 5 members 4 years ago = 38 years

⇒ Present average age of 6 members (with new member) = 44 years

 Present Ages Representation
 
 5 Members' Present Age = 210
 
 
 5 Members' Present Age = 210
 New: 54
 

 Total 6 Members' Present Age = 264

**Calculations:**

⇒ Present average age of the initial 5 members = 38 + 4 = 42 years

⇒ Present sum of ages of these 5 members = 5 × 42 = 210 years

⇒ Present sum of ages of all 6 members = 6 × 44 = 264 years

⇒ Present age of the new member = 264 − 210 = 54 years

**∴ The correct answer is 54 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Concept of Age Progression

If the average age of a group is A years, then after t years, the average age of the same group becomes A + t years, provided no members are added or removed.

Inclusion of a New Member

Age of new member = New Average + Old Number of Members × Change in Average.

Weighted Average

When two groups with n₁ and n₂ members and averages A₁ and A₂ are mixed, the combined average is (n₁ × A₁ + n₂ × A₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).
</p

questions.question: The numbers 5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 13 and N are arranged in ascending order. If the mean of the numbers is equal to the median, the value of N is :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The numbers arranged in ascending order = 5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 13 and N

**Formula used:**

Mean = sum of the terms/Number of the terms

When n is odd,

Median = (n + 1)/2

**Calculation:**

The numbers arranged in ascending order = 5, 7, 8, 10, 12, 13 and N

Mean = (5 + 7 + 8 + 10 + 12 + 13 + N)/7

⇒ (55 + N)/7

Now,

Total number of terms = 7, which is odd

So, Median = (n + 1)/2

⇒ (7 + 1)/2 = 4

The fourth term = 10

Now,

According to the given condition

⇒ (55 + N)/7 = 10

⇒ 55 + N = 70

⇒ N = (70 – 55)

⇒ N = 15

**∴ The required value of N is 15**

questions.question: The simple interest on a certain amount of money is 27% of the principal amount. The time for which the money is lent is one - third of the numerical value of the rate per cent per annum. What is the rate per cent?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The simple interest on a certain amount of money = 27% of principal amount

The time for which the money is lent is one - third of the numerical value of the rate per cent per annum. 

**Formula used:**

SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

Let the principal be 100 and time be T.

According to the question

Time = R/3 years 

⇒ R = 3T

Now,

SI = (P × R × T)/100

⇒ 27 = (100 × 3T × T)/100

⇒ 27 = 3T²

⇒ T² = 9

⇒ T = 3 years

Now,

The rate percent = 3T = (3 × 3) = 9%

**∴ The required rate is 9%**
